Aditi Kapoor  
Chicago, IL | +1 (312) 555-0198 | aditi.kapoor@email.com | linkedin.com/in/aditi.kapoor  

Staff Data Scientist with 14 years of experience driving data-driven innovation in fintech. Spearheaded the development of high-impact machine learning models that reduced fraud losses by 32% and improved credit risk scoring accuracy by 28%. Recognized for architectural decisions that scaled data pipelines across 500+ employees. Specialized in time series analysis, NumPy, and scikit-learn, with a track record of mentoring cross-functional teams and leading production-grade MLOps workflows.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **TensorFlow**: Engineered production models for real-time transaction fraud detection, achieving 98.5% accuracy. Spearheaded the deployment of deep learning architectures that reduced false positives by 22% at PayNet Solutions.  
- **scikit-learn**: Designed scalable pipelines for credit risk assessment, integrating with legacy systems to improve model interpretability. Led the transition to ensemble methods, boosting F1 scores by 19% at FinTech Innovators Inc.  
- **NumPy & Pandas**: Architectural decisions in data preprocessing frameworks that optimized ETL workflows for 500+ data sources. Mentored junior engineers in best practices for handling large-scale time series data.  
- **Time Series Analysis**: Pioneered forecasting models for market volatility, reducing prediction errors by 25% using ARIMA and Prophet. Central to the development of dynamic risk assessment frameworks.  
- **SQL Analytics**: Optimized query performance for 10+ terabytes of transactional data, enabling real-time dashboard updates. Integrated with Tableau for actionable insights in credit scoring.  
- **Tableau/Power BI**: Built interactive dashboards that visualized fraud patterns, driving 30% faster decision-making in risk management.  
- **MLOps (MLflow/W&B)**: Standardized model tracking and deployment processes, reducing deployment cycles by 40% at FinTech Innovators Inc.  
- **A/B Testing**: Designed experiments to validate model performance improvements, ensuring 95% confidence in metric changes across user cohorts.
